+"""RoboWits limited-mode controller for the move_cube episode.
+
+The initial RGB observation locates the red cube in the ego image.  The
+camera calibration converts its image centre at the cube's mid-height into a
+world-frame grasp point.  The left gripper pinches the cube from above, lifts
+over the ramps, carries it past x=0.9, and releases it.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0])  # local +z down; jaws close along world y
+
+
+def save_image(path, img):
+    if img is not None:
+        Image.fromarray(np.asarray(img, dtype=np.uint8)).save(path)
+
+
+def pixel_to_world(cal, uv, z):
+    """Intersect an ego-camera pixel ray with the horizontal plane z."""
+    K = np.asarray(cal["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    ext = np.asarray(cal["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    R, t = ext[:3, :3], ext[:3, 3]
+    C = -R.T @ t
+    ray_cam = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([uv[0], uv[1], 1.0])
+    ray_world = R.T @ ray_cam
+    return C + ((z - C[2]) / ray_world[2]) * ray_world
+
+
+def action_from_obs(obs, left_xyz=None, left_q=None, left_width=None,
+                    right_xyz=None, right_q=None, right_width=None):
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    rpose = now[16:23].copy()
+    lpose = now[23:30].copy()
+    if right_xyz is not None:
+        rpose[:3] = right_xyz
+    if right_q is not None:
+        rpose[3:7] = right_q
+    if left_xyz is not None:
+        lpose[:3] = left_xyz
+    if left_q is not None:
+        lpose[3:7] = left_q
+    rg = now[7] if right_width is None else right_width
+    lg = now[15] if left_width is None else left_width
+    return np.r_[rpose, rg, lpose, lg].astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def move(r, obs, label, xyz, width, q=Q_DOWN):
+    a = action_from_obs(obs, left_xyz=xyz, left_q=q, left_width=width)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, video="none", note=label)
+    print(label, json.dumps({k: res.meta.get(k) for k in
+          ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk", "time_left_s")}, default=str))
+    save_image(OUT / f"{label}_ego.png", res.last.get("ego"))
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("approach", "grasp", "lift", "carry", "release", "all"), default="all")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    save_image(OUT / "initial_ego.png", obs.last.get("ego"))
+    # Red cube centre in the initial ego frame; its geometric centre is at
+    # approximately z=0.785 m.  The fixed seed is based on the live RGB view.
+    cube = pixel_to_world(obs.meta["cameras"]["ego"], (316, 352), 0.785)
+    x, y = float(cube[0]), float(cube[1])
+    print("target_world", [x, y, 0.785], "time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+
+    phases = ["approach", "grasp", "lift", "carry", "release"]
+    if args.phase != "all":
+        phases = phases[:phases.index(args.phase) + 1]
+        phases = phases[-1:]
+    for phase in phases:
+        if phase == "approach":
+            obs = move(r, obs, "approach", [x, y, 0.91], 0.09)
+        elif phase == "grasp":
+            # Descend to the cube centre, close around its sides, then wait
+            # briefly for the parallel jaws to settle.
+            obs = move(r, obs, "descend", [x, y, 0.785], 0.09)
+            obs = move(r, obs, "close", [x, y, 0.785], 0.025)
+        elif phase == "lift":
+            obs = move(r, obs, "lift", [x, y, 0.98], 0.025)
+        elif phase == "carry":
+            obs = move(r, obs, "carry", [0.96, y, 0.98], 0.025)
+        elif phase == "release":
+            obs = move(r, obs, "release", [0.96, y, 0.82], 0.09)
+            obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+            save_image(OUT / "final_ego.png", obs.last.get("ego"))
+            print("final", json.dumps({"done": obs.meta.get("done"), "reason": obs.meta.get("reason"),
+                                        "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                                        "sim_time_s": obs.meta.get("sim_time_s")}))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";

+def save_image(path, img):

+
+
+def pixel_to_world(cal, uv, z):
+    """Intersect an ego-camera pixel ray with the horizontal plane z."""
+    K = np.asarray(cal["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    ext = np.asarray(cal["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    R, t = ext[:3, :3], ext[:3, 3]
+    C = -R.T @ t
+    ray_cam = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([uv[0], uv[1], 1.0])
+    ray_world = R.T @ ray_cam
+    return C + ((z - C[2]) / ray_world[2]) * ray_world
+
+
+def locate_blue(img):
+    """Find the blue cube in the revealed left side of the ego image."""
+    rgb = np.asarray(img, dtype=np.uint8)
+    yy, xx = np.indices(rgb.shape[:2])
+    r, g, b = [rgb[:, :, i].astype(float) for i in range(3)]
+    # Restrict to the table lane where the hidden blue cube appears after the
+    # arms rise; the color ratio excludes the blue background and shadows.
+    mask = ((b > 70) & (b > 1.5 * r) & (b > 1.25 * g) &
+            (xx < 240) & (yy > 250) & (yy < 370))
+    y, x = np.nonzero(mask)
+    if len(x) < 30:

+    return (float(x.mean()), float(y.mean()))

+    row = np.r_[p[16:23], p[7], p[23:30], p[15]].copy()

+
+def pose(r, obs, label, right=None, left=None):

+    # Raise both grippers to clear the table view and the initially occluded

+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    right_high = np.r_[p[16:18], 1.08, p[19:23], 0.09]
+    left_high = np.r_[p[23:25], 1.08, p[26:30], 0.09]
+    res, obs = pose(r, obs, "raise_arms", right_high, left_high)
+    if hold_done(res, obs):

+    save_image(OUT / "cube_view_ego.png", obs.last.get("ego"))
+
+    # Calibrated RGB locates the blue cube.  The target x offset compensates
+    # for the observed tip tracking bias during the vertical descent.
+    uv = locate_blue(obs.last["ego"])
+    cube = pixel_to_world(obs.meta["cameras"]["ego"], uv, 0.785)
+    gx = float(cube[0] - 0.006)
+    gy = float(cube[1] + 0.001)
+    print("blue_pixel", uv, "grasp_xy", [gx, gy], "time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+
+    left = np.r_[gx, gy, 0.90, Q_DOWN, 0.09]
+    res, obs = pose(r, obs, "blue_pregrasp", RIGHT_HOME, left)
+    if hold_done(res, obs):

+
+    # Descend below the cube top; the last few millimetres matter for contact.
+    left = np.r_[gx - 0.010, gy, 0.765, Q_DOWN, 0.09]
+    res, obs = pose(r, obs, "blue_descend", RIGHT_HOME, left)
+    if hold_done(res, obs):

+    left[7] = 0.025
+    res, obs = pose(r, obs, "blue_close", RIGHT_HOME, left)
+    if hold_done(res, obs):

+    # Lift, rotate about the jaw axis, and bring the cube into the left arm's

+        left = np.r_[x, 0.30, z, Q_CARRY_L, 0.025]
